scope: Captured immutable index/HEAD/tracked-file removal plans before confirmation and revalidation per ordered rm
Native normal Delete/keep-local pair with owned Remove/Abort and Ignore/Abort questions
Bounded streamed progress, direct preparation cancellation, ConfirmKillProcess for running attempts and retained summary
Full operation lease/counter/Quit lifetime and suppression of retired replies/callbacks
One parent refresh after actual attempted effects; Working Tree routes its captured repository

debug.diagnostics: Existing exit-zero/no-output compiler diagnostics; no clean-diagnostics claim.

evidence: Actual normal removal deletes working file and index entry
Keep-local ordered batch preserves working files while stale replacement is refused and Ignore proceeds
Captured result emits one parent refresh
Real gated rm output streams while Quit is blocked; cancellation preserves pre-gate index and file
Forced close retains pending confirmation work in active count and rejects its later affirmative response

limitations: Metadata revalidation is not a filesystem transaction
Progress/result window adapts source informational dialogs; physical layout/sheets/keyboard/themes remain unverified
Complete submodule/gitmodules, installed Finder routing and signed/minimum-OS acceptance remain open
No full hosted CI or whole-port/App Store certification
